verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "10-day mission" (R2, R5, R6, R8, R9); "MISSION DURATION 9 Days, 1 Hour, 32 Minutes" approx 10 days (R4); "approximately 10-day trip" (R3); "approximately 10-day mission" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state or approximate a 10-day crewed test mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "testing the Orion spacecraft" (R1); "check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey" (R2); "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems... in deep space" (R3); "test flight of... the Orion spacecraft" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state validation/testing of Orion in deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate SLS rocket in deep space.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "evaluating the performance of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket along with the Orion spacecraft... in deep space" (R3, but SLS expended early); "test flight of... the SLS rocket" (R5, launch phase)
verifications.reasoning: SLS is tested during launch/ascent, not in deep space (upper stage to high Earth orbit only); claim misattributes deep space validation to SLS.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "checking... life support" (R2); "test essential life support systems" (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5); "validate the life-support... systems that keep astronauts alive in deep space" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for testing life-support in deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed trip around the moon in more than 50 years" (R1); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972" (R3); "first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm first crewed lunar mission since Apollo >50 years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft" around moon (R1); "four astronauts toward... around the moon" (R2); "fly four astronauts around the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistent across sources.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test essential life support systems aboard the spacecraft" with crew (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "life support systems" includes environmental control (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify life-support, which broadly encompasses environmental control, but not explicitly named.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Guidance, navigation, and communications"; "onboard navigation sensors" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Explicit testing of navigation with crew.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts... around the moon" (R1); "lifting four astronauts... around the moon" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II journey passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond the Moon.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "4,000 miles above the surface" (R2); "Distance 4,067 mi" closest approach (R3); "over 4,000 miles beyond the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources cite ~4,000-4,067 miles closest approach/beyond; 4,700 is roughly approximate.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ms. Koch... first woman to do so [venture into deep space]" (R2); "Christina Koch the first woman" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states Koch as first woman beyond LEO/deep space.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Glover... first Black man to venture into deep space" (R2); "Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Direct attribution to Glover.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Hansen... first person on a moon mission who is not an American" (R2); "Jeremy Hansen... first non-U.S. citizen" (R3); "first Canadian to go to the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly Hansen as first Canadian beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "farthest that any humans have traveled from Earth: 252,799 miles" (R2); "set the record for human distance from Earth" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Mission sets new human distance record.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis III.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "data will directly inform... Artemis III" (R6); "paving the way for... Artemis III" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify preparation for Artemis III.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis IV.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.evidence: No relevant content found
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention preparation for future/Artemis III, not specifically IV.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for future missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lay the groundwork for future exploration" (R1); "clear a path for more exploration" (R2); "supporting subsequent Artemis missions" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Broadly supports future missions.

verifications.claim: Artemis III will land humans on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Artemis III, which aims to return astronauts to the lunar surface" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Artemis III as landing mission (planned).

verifications.claim: Artemis IV will land humans on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Artemis III... land astronauts on the Moon"; "Artemis IV and beyond... construct... Gateway" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Artemis III is the first landing; IV is Gateway/not landing.

verifications.claim: Future missions will land humans on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "returning humans to the moon" (R1); "land astronauts on the Moon" future (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Program plans lunar landings.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Reid Wiseman, the NASA astronaut who is the commander" (R2); "commander Reid Wiseman" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All crew lists confirm.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Victor Glover, who is scheduled to pilot" (R1); "Victor Glover, the Artemis II pilot" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Consistent crew assignment.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Christina Koch" mission specialist (R2, R3, etc.)
verifications.reasoning: All sources list her as MS.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Jeremy Hansen" mission specialist (R2, R3, etc.)
verifications.reasoning: Consistent across sources.
